source.author: ov
source.text: Forte fuit iuxta signis exstantibus asper antiquus crater; quem vastum vastior ipso sustulit Aegides adversaque misit in ora.
source.text_original: Forte fuit iuxta signis exstantibus asper / antiquus crater; quem vastum vastior ipso / sustulit Aegides adversaque misit in ora.
source.text_english: By chance there was nearby, with figures standing out, an old rough crater; this, huge, the son of Aegis-bearing Zeus lifted up, and hurled it against his hostile face.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: crateres mensaeque volant araeque deorum poculaque, insignis veterum labor.
reuse.text_original: crateres mensaeque volant araeque deorum / poculaque, insignis veterum labor.
reuse.text_english: craters and tables and altars of the gods fly about, and cups, a notable workmanship of the ancients.
